name: koozee
description: Create Fashion Workflows on a Free Canvas. Batch-Generate Fashion Images and Videos.

interface.longDescription: Create fashion workflows on a free visual canvas. Batch-generate AI fashion images and videos, add cards, and connect them into one look. Use a Koozee Skill such as virtual try-on when the job is a product rather than a free generation. Credits match the canvas. After the canvas changes, open the project link Koozee returns.
defaultPrompt: Create a fashion workflow on a free canvas and batch-generate images and videos
